title: State-change relevance

questions.text: Is the proposed action actually responding to what changed?

inputs: recent changes: summary, material diff fields, signals

criteria.text: the action addresses the material change
criteria.guide: The action's subject is what changed (new blocker, request, stakeholder), not an older salient topic.

criteria.text: the change justifies an action at all
criteria.guide: A non-deal change (third-party observation, our own note) does not justify customer contact.

failure_examples: A new security blocker appeared, but the agent generates a generic pricing follow-up because pricing was historically salient.
